finding: The pilot relation Delta U = Q_in - W_by is an internal-energy form of the first law. The more general energy balance applies to total system energy, including macroscopic kinetic and potential energy where relevant.
required_applicability_condition_before_: Use the Delta U form only when macroscopic kinetic and potential energy changes are negligible, zero, or separately accounted outside the internal-energy balance.
sign_convention_constraint: Positive W_by denotes work done by the system; any alternate convention must change the algebra consistently.

source_refs.selection_reason: The MIT Unified Engineering treatment states the general first-law balance in terms of total system energy and separately identifies internal, kinetic and potential energy contributions.

resolution_rule: A later semantic revision may close this review only by adding the macroscopic-energy applicability condition to the governed relation and updating every dependent verification/base-claim statement consistently; schema validity alone cannot close the review.
